criteria.detail: the count below the subsistence floor answers the carrier: it reads 75 at need 0.1, 154 at need 0.5. **A null on a reading that cannot move is not a null**, so this is checked before anything else is read. And the books close on 2970 of 2970 cells, which is the conservation check every round already carries
criteria.name: A36-1

criteria.detail: on 90 carriers, each run through 33 collection rules, **the count below the floor is the same under every one of them**: the spread within a carrier is zero on 90 of 90 and non-zero on 0. The rules are two positions at three shapes each, and the nine shape pairs across those two positions at three shares
criteria.name: A36-2

criteria.detail: within one carrier the amount collected differs across the rules by up to 105.6% of the smallest, the convention A31 and A34 use, and by a median of 4.9%, and across all 2970 cells it runs from 0.7539 to 29.2451, a factor of 38.8. **So the shapes really do collect different amounts from different accounts**, and the null above is not the comparison of two runs that were the same run
criteria.name: A36-3

criteria.detail: a mixed cell collects an amount different from both of its own single-position runs on 2376 of 2430. **A field that was silently inert would return one of the two every time**, and `mix` had never been exercised by any station before this one, so that is the first thing to rule out. **The 54 that do coincide are one class and not a scatter**: stress ['leak'] at share [0.25], where the financial layer holds so little that its quarter of the take is capped at what is there and the rest falls on production, so the total is the production-only run. **The cap closing the gap on a thin side is the field working, not the field being inert**
criteria.name: A36-4

criteria.detail: A31's first round moved which position the claims come out of and read the same count; its second round moved the shape inside one position and read the same count; **this one puts a different shape on each of two positions at once, at three ratios, and reads the same count again**. Across needs [0.1, 0.2] and stresses ['healthy', 'leak', 'leak_recycled'], on 90 carriers. **Three independent ways of moving where the same pinned aggregate comes from, and the count below the floor has not moved under any of them**
criteria.name: A36-5

criteria.detail: the books close on 2970 of 2970 cells, and this station's single-position cell is A31's own: same count below the floor and the same amount removed to within 1e-09, run through A31's driver. **The two stations share the carrier and the driver**, so a disagreement would be a real one and the null above would be about a different economy
criteria.name: A36-6

criteria.detail: the results file names this station against A31s registration, so a reader of A31's second round finds what two shapes at once do. `D20`
